text: 【证监会：针对市场热点难点会计实务问题加强实践指导 不断增强资本市场执行企业会计准则与财务信息披露规则的一致性、有效性】中国证监会组织专门力量抽样审阅了上市公司2025年年度财务报告，在此基础上形成了《上市公司2025年年度财务报告会计监管报告》。针对市场热点难点会计实务问题加强实践指导，不断增强资本市场执行企业会计准则与财务信息披露规则的一致性、有效性。
text_en: [CSRC: Strengthen practical guidance on hot and difficult accounting issues in the market, continuously enhance consistency and effectiveness of capital markets' implementation of corporate accounting standards and financial disclosure rules] CSRC organized dedicated teams to sample-review listed companies' 2025 annual financial reports, forming the '2025 Annual Financial Report Accounting Supervision Report for Listed Companies'. Strengthen practical guidance on hot and difficult accounting issues in the market, continuously enhance consistency and effectiveness of capital markets' implementation of corporate accounting standards and financial disclosure rules.
